Equipment used: Two-handed weapon and light/medium armor;Default Bar:HP/SP;The warrior dominates the battlefield by swinging a great sword larger than his height like a storm. Warriors, who can use large-scale skills by collecting SP through attacks, are better suited to attacking multiple enemies than any other class.

Equipment used: One-handed sword and light armor;Basic Bar:HP/SP/Critical Sphere;Rogue's lightning-fast movements are often mistaken for teleportation. A skilled rogue can exploit the opponent's gap in the blink of an eye and deliver a finishing technique with a critical orb collected after a heavy hit, inflicting fatal wounds.

Equipment used: guns and light armor;Default Bar:HP/SP;Gunslingers are experts in various firearms and explosives. Gunslingers use overwhelming firepower and range to fight without even allowing the enemy to get close. There are no blind spots for the gunslinger, who can attack from all directions with a variety of weapons.

Equipment used: Spear and light/medium armor;Basic Bar:HP/SP/Critical Sphere;The knight's defense power, which treats his shield like a part of his body, is at the highest level. In addition, the turning blow that consumes the critical spheres collected while blocking attacks shows that he also has the strongest spear.
